#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================



#====================================================================================================
# Testing Data - Main Agent and testing sub agent both should log testing data below this section
#====================================================================================================

user_problem_statement: "Build a full-stack website to manage university PDFs with reminder and scheduler features. Core features include PDF upload/management, categorization by subject, reminders for deadlines, and weekly scheduler with calendar view."

backend:
  - task: "PDF Upload and Management API"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Implemented complete PDF management system with upload, download, view, delete endpoints. Added file validation, unique filename generation, and secure file storage in uploads directory."
      - working: true
        agent: "testing"
        comment: "Tested PDF upload, validation, listing, filtering by subject, retrieval by ID, and deletion. All endpoints are working correctly. File validation properly rejects non-PDF files. PDF files are stored with UUID-based filenames and can be accessed via the /uploads endpoint."

  - task: "PDF File Storage and Serving"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Created uploads directory mounting with FastAPI StaticFiles. Files are stored with UUID filenames and served securely through /uploads endpoint."
      - working: true
        agent: "testing"
        comment: "Verified that uploaded PDF files are properly stored in the uploads directory with UUID-based filenames. Files can be accessed via the /uploads/{filename} endpoint. The StaticFiles mounting is working correctly."

  - task: "Reminders CRUD API"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: false

        agent: "main"
        comment: "Implemented complete reminders system with create, read, update, delete, and toggle completion endpoints."
      - working: true

        comment: "Fixed an issue with date handling in the Reminder model - changed date type to string to ensure MongoDB compatibility. Tested all reminder endpoints: creation, listing, filtering by completion status, updating, toggling completion, and deletion. All endpoints are working correctly after the fix."

  - task: "Schedule/Calendar CRUD API"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "/app/backend/server.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
      - working: "NA"
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Implemented schedule management with weekly calendar support, color coding, and day-of-week organization."
      - working: true
        agent: "testing"
        comment: "Tested all schedule endpoints: creation, listing, updating, and deletion. The API correctly handles day-of-week values, time ranges, and color coding. All endpoints are working as expected."

metadata:
  created_by: "main_agent"
  version: "1.0"
  test_sequence: 1
  run_ui: false

test_plan:
  current_focus:
    - "PDF Upload and Management API"
    - "PDF File Storage and Serving"
    - "PDF Upload Interface"
    - "PDF List and Management UI"
    - "PDF Viewer Integration"
  stuck_tasks: []
  test_all: false
  test_priority: "high_first"

agent_communication:
  - agent: "main"
    message: "Implemented complete PDF management system (Phase 1) with upload, storage, viewing, and management capabilities. Core backend APIs and frontend UI are ready for testing. Focus on PDF upload workflow, file serving, and viewer functionality."
  - agent: "testing"
    message: "Completed testing of all backend APIs. Fixed an issue with the Reminders API where date objects couldn't be stored in MongoDB - changed the model to use string dates instead. All backend endpoints are now working correctly: PDF upload and management, PDF file storage and serving, Reminders CRUD operations, and Schedule/Calendar management. The backend is ready for frontend integration."
